Presenting YAALALO YAALALO Video Song from Irumudi featuring Ravi Teja.
With music by GV Prakash Kumar, vocals by Hesham, and lyrics by Shiva Nirvana, this vibrant track brings together soulful melodies, energetic beats, and captivating visuals.
Experience the musical magic of YAALALO YAALALO and enjoy Ravi Teja in this exciting song from Irumudi.
Song Name: Yaalalo Yaalalo
Music by G V Prakash Kumar
Singer : Hesham Abdul Wahab,Sadhika K.R
Lyrics :- Ananth Sriram
